import sys,json,csv,io,base64,subprocess,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd
HDR='type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload\n'
GOOD=HDR+'icmp,a,0,1,put,h,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n'
def base_job(captures):
 return {'version':3,'seed':'x','leases':[{'id':'h','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}],
 'services':[{'id':'t','kind':'tcp'}],'queries':[10],'captures':captures,'requests':[],'offers':[],
 'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
def run(job):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],input=json.dumps(job).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 try:return p.returncode,json.loads(p.stdout),p.stderr.decode()[:200]
 except Exception:return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
def chunks(data,n):
 return [base64.b64encode(data[i:i+n]).decode() for i in range(0,len(data),n)]
def zcap(data,n=7):
 return {'encoding':'zstd','chunks':chunks(data,n)}
def ccap(text): return {'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(text.encode()).decode()]}

# 1 zstd normal, split
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor()
raw=GOOD.encode().replace(b'\n',b'\r\n')
rc,out,err=run(base_job([zcap(c.compress(raw),3)]))
print('zstd normal',rc,out.get('rejected') if isinstance(out,dict) else out, 'err',err)

# 2 multiple frames + skippable
f1=c.compress(GOOD[:30].encode());f2=c.compress(GOOD[30:].encode())
sk=(0x184d2a5f).to_bytes(4,'little')+(5).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'abcde'
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(f1+sk+f2).decode()]}]))
print('zstd concat skip',rc,out.get('rejected') if isinstance(out,dict) else out)

# 3 reserved bit
d=bytearray(c.compress(GOOD.encode())); d[4]|=0x08
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(bytes(d)).decode()]}]))
print('reserved',rc,out)
# 4 dictionary flag nonzero

# need insert dict id byte; easier build manually? set flag and insert 0 byte after window

rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(bytes(d2)).decode()]}]))
print('dictflag',rc,out)
# 5 checksum error
cc=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True); d=bytearray(cc.compress(GOOD.encode())); d[-1]^=1
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(bytes(d)).decode()]}]))
print('checksum',rc,out)
# 6 truncation
d=c.compress(GOOD.encode())[:-2]
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(d).decode()]}]))
print('truncated',rc,out)
# 7 invalid utf8 plain
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'csv','chunks':[base64.b64encode(b'\xff\xfe\n').decode()]}]))
print('bad utf8',rc,out)
# 8 invalid csv quote
rc,out,err=run(base_job([ccap('type,id\n"unterminated\n')]))
print('bad csv',rc,out)
# 9 wrong header
rc,out,err=run(base_job([ccap('a,b,c\n')]))
print('bad header',rc,out)
# 10 blank record and bad record indexing

rc,out,err=run(base_job([ccap(text)]))
print('rejections',rc,out.get('rejected') if isinstance(out,dict) else out)
# 11 empty capture
rc,out,err=run(base_job([{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['']}]))
print('empty capture',rc,out)
# 12 invalid metadata + capture error precedence
j=base_job([{'encoding':'csv','chunks':['!!!']}]);j['version']=4
rc,out,err=run(j)
print('precedence',rc,out)
